name: gitlab-tools
description: Internal GitLab tools. The first tool collects merge request review comments.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @gitlab-tools/server" "npm run dev -w @gitlab-tools/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gitlab-tools/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gitlab-tools/server && npm run typecheck -w @gitlab-tools/client
